description: Search the UK Register of Charities by name and return matching registered charities with their charity number, registration status, registered address and latest reported income. AUTHORITATIVE for charities in England and Wales — this is the Charity Commission's own register, the legal record. This source requires an API key: Pipeworx does not front one today, so pass your own free Charity Commission subscription key as _apiKey. Example: ukcharity_search({ query: "oxfam" })

_apiKey.description: Optional BYO override: your own free Charity Commission subscription key. Pipeworx does not front a key for this source today, so a call without one is refused. Register at api-portal.charitycommission.gov.uk and subscribe to the Register of Charities product.

query.description: Charity name or part of it, e.g. "oxfam", "royal society"

registered_only.description: Only charities currently on the register, excluding removed ones (default false)

name: ukcharity_search
title: Ukcharity Search
